name: youtube_search_videos
description: Search YouTube through the YouTube Android app's own InnerTube API (guest session, no login). `items` holds the video results (id, title, watch URL, channel, view count, duration); `results` holds every result kind in page order — videos, Shorts, playlists and channels — each tagged with its kind. Also returns the estimated total and a continuation token. Pass `continuation` (from a previous call) to fetch the next page; filters and sort are the app's own search parameters.

query.description: Search keywords. Required unless `continuation` is given.

continuation.description: Continuation token from a previous youtube_search_videos result (`next_continuation`); fetches the next page of that search.

upload_date.description: Only videos uploaded within this window.

duration.description: Duration filter: short (under 4 min), medium (4-20 min), long (over 20 min).

name: youtube_get_video
description: Get one YouTube video's details through the app's InnerTube API: title, channel, length, view count, description, keywords, thumbnail, caption tracks. The like count is merged from the watch-next response and the exact view count plus the relative upload time (upload_time_text, e.g. "5y ago") from updated_metadata — the same entities the app renders. No response in the app's flow carries an absolute calendar publish date, so published_date stays null.

video_id.description: Video id (e.g. "5C_HPTJg5ek"), or a watch / Shorts / youtu.be URL.

name: youtube_get_related
description: Get the related videos shown next to a YouTube video (the app's watch-next list, about 20 entries with title, channel, view count and duration), the watched video's like count, and the continuation tokens: related_continuation pages this list (pass it back as `continuation`), comments_continuation opens the comments section — pass it to youtube_get_comments.

video_id.description: Video id, or a watch / Shorts / youtu.be URL. Required unless `continuation` is given.

continuation.description: Related-list continuation token from a previous youtube_get_related result (`related_continuation`).

name: youtube_get_captions
description: Get a YouTube video's caption transcript through the app's own two-step caption flow (player-issued track URL, then the timedtext document). Returns the cues with timestamps plus the joined text. `language` selects a track by language code; without it a manual track is preferred over the automatic (ASR) one.

video_id.description: Video id, or a watch / Shorts / youtu.be URL.

name: youtube_get_comments
description: Get one page of a YouTube video's comments (about 20, with author, text, like count text and reply count) through the app's InnerTube next API. The first page's token comes from youtube_get_related (`comments_continuation`); the result's `next_continuation` fetches the following page.

continuation.description: Comments continuation token from youtube_get_related or a previous youtube_get_comments result.

name: bilibili_get_video
description: Get one Bilibili video's details through the app's viewunite View call, as a guest — no login. Identify the video by BV id / video URL (video_id) or by numeric aid. Returns title, author, cover, description, duration, play/danmaku/like/coin/favorite/share counts, publish time and the part (分P) list.

video_id.description: BV id (e.g. "BV1xx411c7mD") or a bilibili video URL.

aid.description: Numeric av id; alternative to video_id.

name: bilibili_get_related
description: Get the related videos Bilibili shows next to a video (viewunite RelatesFeed), as a guest — no login. Identify the video by BV id / video URL (video_id) or by numeric aid. `next` continues the feed.

video_id.description: BV id or a bilibili video URL.

aid.description: Numeric av id; alternative to video_id.

next.description: Pagination token from a previous result; omit for the first page.

name: bilibili_search_videos
description: Search Bilibili videos through the Bilibili Android app's own gRPC search (SearchAll), as a guest — no login. Returns title, BV id, author, cover, duration, play and danmaku counts and the watch URL, plus a `next` token for paging.

query.description: Search keywords. Chinese works best; Bilibili is a Chinese platform.

next.description: Pagination token from a previous result's `next` field; omit for the first page.

order.description: Sort order code of the app's SearchAll request (0 = comprehensive, the app default). Passed through unchanged.

tid_list.description: Region (tid) filter, in the app's own list format. Passed through unchanged.

duration_list.description: Duration filter, in the app's own list format. Passed through unchanged.

pub_time_begin_s.description: Only videos published at or after this unix timestamp (seconds).

pub_time_end_s.description: Only videos published at or before this unix timestamp (seconds).
